name: Unidentified BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber (Adi Gallia's flagship)
description: A BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber was used by the protocol droid C-3PO and the astromech droid R2-D2 to escape Adi Gallia's flagship during the Battle of Patitite Pattuna.
